title: Delayed shopfit blamed on site access
description: Precision were meant to finish fitting out our new Leeds store by 4 August 2025 so we could open for the back-to-school season. They finished on 29 August. We estimate we lost about £40,000 of sales. Precision say they could not start on time because our landlord's contractor was still on site and we did not give them site access.
notes: Causation is genuinely disputed. Open questions should ask about site access dates.
